author_or_institution: Roger Fouquet and Peter J. G. Pearson
title: Seven Centuries of Energy Services: The Price and Use of Light in the United Kingdom (1300-2000)
source_type: Peer-reviewed historical reconstruction of lighting-service prices and consumption
book_use: Chapter 5 evidence that the real cost of lighting services collapsed while per-capita lighting consumption rose dramatically, supporting the distinction between energy inputs and energy services; estimates are reconstructed from historical prices, technologies, and assumptions rather than direct measurements across the full period
